note: PMIDs that must never be indexed as corpus papers. Each resolves to a real PubMed record - that is precisely why every existence-checking gate passed it. The disqualifier is PROVENANCE, not existence: nothing in this repo ever cited these as evidence for a claim. This registry is PERSISTENT so that re-ingestion cannot reintroduce them, and so the reason survives after the index is clean. Enforced by audit_index_provenance.py (which fails the build if an entry here is present in the index) and honoured by ingest_papers.py.

12345678.actual_title: Denpasar Declaration on Population and Development.

The index harvester read a regex example as a citation. It was rendered as a corpus paper on Paper_Library.html and PMID_Verification.html.
